changelog:
v3.4.2 — Buffer & Decoder Recovery Fix

• Reduced VOD/Series buffer cap from 90s to 45s — prevents OOM on mid-range devices
• HIGH quality buffer capped at 60s (was 120s)
• Smart watchdog: HW decoder proven good at 24fps won't fallback to software decoder
• Hard reset recovery (stop/prepare/play) for post-rebuffer black screens instead of seek flush
• Fixes black screen loops on mt8696 Fire TV Sticks caused by memory pressure
